@graph.name: Web3 Partnership Announcement PR
@graph.description: PR for Web3 partnership, integration and feature launches: finding the real news hook, building the joint narrative between both teams, and running the tier-1 outreach that gets partnership announcements covered instead of ignored. Placements in CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block and Blockworks.

mainEntity.name: What is partnership announcement PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the media strategy and outreach that turns a partnership, integration or feature launch into an actual news story instead of a blog post nobody reads. It is for Web3 and AI founders and BD teams who have a real integration or joint launch coming and want it in tier-1 crypto and mainstream outlets rather than just their own channels. Most projects only get one real shot at coverage per partnership, so the hook and the pitch have to be right the first time.

mainEntity.name: How much does partnership announcement PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single partnership announcement usually fits inside a fractional monthly retainer of $5K–$12K, alongside other PR work. For a standalone push tied to a bigger launch, a sprint runs $15K–$40K over a shorter window. A full agency retainer covering ongoing partnership PR runs $15K–$45K per month.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets actually cover partnership announcements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant, and mainstream crossover in Forbes or Bloomberg when the angle is big enough. Coverage depends entirely on the news hook: a first-of-its-kind integration or a measurable number gets picked up, a generic partnership post does not, regardless of the outlet list.

mainEntity.name: What is the process and how long does it take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start four to six weeks before the announcement date if possible: find the hook, align both teams on one narrative, then run a 5-10 day embargo to a tier-1 editor before wider release. When the hook is strong and both teams move fast, turnaround from brief to placement can be as fast as 48 hours.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with Shilika Jain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on whether your partnership has a real news hook, or book a 30-minute call to plot the pitch live.
